verdict.rationale: Numeral calculates tax amounts that native integrations apply at checkout or invoice time, validates customer VAT IDs live, and manages registrations across global jurisdictions. There is no evidence that it puts required VAT invoice fields, seller or buyer registration numbers, or locale-specific invoice rules onto invoices, or that it generates compliant invoices itself. Missing for 10: documented VAT invoice field and registration-number propagation to invoicing systems, locale-specific invoice compliance rules, native compliant invoice generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
